profile: Surrozen is a biotechnology company developing therapies that modulate the Wnt pathway, with current development focused on ophthalmology. Its product candidates are antibody-based therapeutics designed to affect Wnt signaling in eye diseases. The company is developing SZN-8141 and SZN-8143 for retinal conditions, while evaluating research programs in other ophthalmic indications. It has licensed SZN-413 to Boehringer Ingelheim for research, development, and commercialization.
